offering_description.value: HealthStream provides healthcare organizations with software for workforce learning, clinical development, credentialing, scheduling, onboarding, and compliance. Its integrated platform brings these workflows together and supports resuscitation training, quality and safety, and revenue cycle operations.

quotes.quote: HealthStream is a leading healthcare technology platform company for clinical workforce solutions, helping healthcare organizations train develop staff, track meet compliance requirements, manage credentialing credential providers, assess competencies, schedule staff, support onboarding, and improve workforce performance. It brings together multiple workforce processes so teams can work more efficiently and maintain readiness across the organization.

Trisha L. Coady joined HealthStream and, following her role as Senior Vice President, she was named Executive Vice President, Workforce Development Solutions in. Ms. Coady is responsible for the suite of solutions that includes competency development, clinical education, resuscitation, quality and safety, and revenue cycle, working with many of HealthStream’s leading partners. As a nurse, former healthcare entrepreneur, and nationally recognized thought leader on learning and development for healthcare professionals, her expertise helps guide HealthStream’s various product innovations and go-to-market strategy in the area of workforce development. Prior to coming to HealthStream, Ms. Coady was the healthcare Practice Manager at Bluedrop Performance Learning; founder and President of Medsenses; and a registered nurse at several healthcare organizations. She holds a Bachelor of Science in Nursing from the University of Moncton.

primary_products.value: Learning management software; clinical education, competency, and resuscitation tools; provider credentialing software; staff scheduling software; quality, safety, and revenue cycle tools

quotes.quote: Kevin O’Hara most recently joined HealthStream and, following several promotions, is currently serving as Executive Vice President, Workforce Platform & Applications. In this role, Mr. O’Hara is responsible for the Company’s innovative, PaaS-enabled hStream platform and the core application suites in Learning, Credentialing, and Scheduling. Prior to his current role at HealthStream, Mr. Mr. O’Hara was then Chief Executive Officer at Syus, a healthcare IT company, for a decade before re-joining HealthStream. customer_segment.value: B2B: Hospitals, health systems, ambulatory care organizations, long-term care facilities, skilled nursing facilities, and medical practices; B2C: Individual healthcare professionals reached through its direct professional channel

quotes.quote: HealthStream is used by healthcare organizations that need to manage workforce learning, compliance, credentialing, and performance scheduling at scale. This can include hospitals, health systems, ambulatory organizations, and other long-term care, skilled nursing facilities, practices along withother care delivery settings looking to improve workforce readiness and operational efficiency.

Scott McQuigg joined HealthStream and is currently serving as Senior Vice President, Digital & Network Development. Mr. McQuigg is focused on advancing the Company’s business-to-professional channel, expanding upon and growing HealthStream’s direct relationships with healthcare professionals. Prior to joining HealthStream, Mr. McQuigg was cofounder & Chief Executive Officer of GoNoodle, the transformational kids’ media and tech platform that grew to over 14 million+ kids engaged each month. Mr. McQuigg was also cofounder & Chief Executive Officer of HealthLeaders, a leading media, publishing, and research business focused on the business of healthcare. Previously, he served as President & Publisher of the Nashville Business Journal.
